name_input: ELECTRONICA MECHATRONIC SYSTEMS I PVT LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (slug: electronica-mechatronic-systems-india-pvt-ltd) shows 5 records, all dated 2024-01-16, all with Origin=Savannah (USA) and Destination=JNPT, India, HS 90318000, BOL 9690804, description 'RE-IMPORT AFTER EXHIBITION GOODS : I VISTA 2015 (CODE VCEC-GA-00LF)'. These are inbound re-imports of goods returned from a US exhibition, not outbound export shipments. No outbound export bill of lading with an Indian origin and foreign destination was found. Source counter: page header states 'Total Shipments 5 Records detected' and exactly 5 rows were rendered — counter matches rows seen.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, or annual-report domestic revenue split could be retrieved. thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403; eximpedia, trademo, volza and importgenius all returned HTTP 403 / JS challenge; DuckDuckGo search backend was unavailable ('Connection refused') for the whole session, so no domestic-supply page could be located. Field left null rather than estimated.
note: Legal entity exists and is active in customs data as ELECTRONICA MECHATRONIC SYSTEMS (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED (address fragment in ImportKey buyer block: '37, ELECTRONIC CO-OPERATIVE ESTATE LTD., PUNE - SATARA ROAD', i.e. Pune, Maharashtra). Declared HS 903180 is consistent with the observed customs HS 90318000 (height gauges / measuring instruments: 'PLATINA HEIGHT GAUGE 700MM ULTIMA M 700', 'OPTIMA H 450 MM'), so no HS correction is needed. IMPORTANT on Rule 5: the only shipment evidence is INBOUND — five re-import entries of the company's own exhibition equipment returning from Savannah, USA via JNPT on 2024-01-16 under a single BOL 9690804. That proves the company exhibited abroad and shipped goods out temporarily, but it is not evidence of commercial export sales, and no export B/L with a foreign consignee was seen. On the domestic side there are no traces of supplies found in the sources reachable this session — this is a research gap, not a proven absence, so domestic_status is 'unknown' rather than 'none_found'. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). No CIN or PAN verified — the CIN in the attempted thecompanycheck URL was a guess and is NOT confirmed, so it is deliberately omitted. Recommendation: do not treat as an exporter on this evidence; re-run domestic verification (MCA/GST/GeM) when search access is restored.
